objective: Add the first real deterministic Minecraft skill through a fixed typed registry: look.v1 validates a bounded target, executes exactly once through Mineflayer, obeys timeout and emergency cancellation, and reports success only when a post-action yaw/pitch state verifier agrees.
non_goals: Do not add LLM planning, generated code, eval, shell, arbitrary callbacks or runtime plugin registration.
Do not add movement, pathfinding, collection, crafting, storage, eating, fleeing, combat, chat, sign, book or destructive actions.
Do not add a mutating HTTP endpoint, dashboard control or non-loopback listener in this slice.
Do not retry a failed action, infer success from Mineflayer promise resolution alone or allow the caller to raise timeout/attempt budgets.
Do not run a real Minecraft server smoke, repeated task benchmark or mechanical-success promotion gate without an owner-provided resettable server.
contracts: The registry is static and exposes exactly look.v1 in this slice; runtime callers cannot register code or alter budgets.
look.v1 accepts exactly finite yawRadians and pitchRadians, with yaw in [-pi, pi] and pitch in [-pi/2, pi/2]; unknown fields and skill IDs fail closed.
Execution requires an online non-emergency controller, one visible player state and no other active skill.
The fixed budget is one attempt with a 2000 ms timeout and no destructive capability.
Mineflayer promise resolution is not success evidence; the normalized post-state must match yaw and pitch within a fixed angular tolerance.
Timeout, postcondition mismatch, vendor error and emergency cancellation return stable bounded failures and never retry.
Emergency stop aborts the active skill before clearing local controls and disconnecting.
No chat, sign, book, scoreboard, plugin payload, model output or arbitrary code enters skill validation or execution.
allowed_dependencies: Node.js standard library and the already-pinned Mineflayer 4.37.1 adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Registry tests prove only look.v1 exists and its fixed precondition, timeout, one-attempt budget, postcondition and non-destructive metadata are immutable to callers.
Validation tests reject unknown skills, extra or missing fields, non-finite values and out-of-range angles before Mineflayer receives an action.
Controller tests prove success requires state verification and cover precondition failure, busy concurrency, timeout, vendor error, postcondition mismatch and emergency cancellation.
MineflayerBotPort and its real adapter call the official bot.look API without exposing a vendor type through the public package entrypoint.
Adapter build/tests, repository fast tests, module-brief validation, GitNexus change scan and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M09-S2-look-skill-registry-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
